# LostStreet

> LostStreet is a free, browser-based geography guessing game and GeoGuessr alternative at https://www.loststreet.online

## What is LostStreet?
LostStreet is a multiplayer geography game where players guess real-world locations from Google Street View panoramas. Players drop a pin on a map to guess where they are. The closer the guess, the higher the score.

## Key Features
- 100% free to play (no subscription required)
- Singleplayer with Easy, Medium, and Hard difficulty
- Real-time multiplayer duels with ELO rating
- Private party mode (create/join with 6-digit code)
- Daily challenge with streak tracking
- Google Sign-In for progress tracking
- Works on desktop and mobile browsers

## Game Modes
- **Easy Mode**: Multiple choice questions about the location
- **Medium Mode**: Mix of multiple choice and map pinning
- **Hard Mode**: Pin your guess directly on the world map
- **Multiplayer**: Real-time 1v1 duels with matchmaking
- **Party Mode**: Play with friends using a shared room code
- **Daily Challenge**: One challenge per day with streak bonuses

## Technical Details
- Built with Next.js and React
- Uses Google Maps Street View API
- Firebase Authentication and Firestore
- Real-time multiplayer via Firestore listeners
- Responsive design for mobile and desktop

## Comparison to Alternatives
| Feature | LostStreet | GeoGuessr | WorldGuessr |
|---------|-----------|-----------|-------------|
| Free to play | ✅ Unlimited | ❌ Paid after 1 game/day | ✅ Free |
| Multiplayer | ✅ Real-time duels | ✅ | ❌ |
| Party mode | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ |
| Daily challenge | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| No account needed | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ |
